messages.content: I’ll build the day-ahead book around evening energy sales and regulation-down revenue, with reserves limited by battery charge and shared-meter headroom. I’ll then manage the fixed AS awards through each live watch.

The battery is nearly full heading into the peak hours. Regulation-down charging was lighter than forecast this morning, so I’m checking a smaller 19:00 discharge to give the fixed late-evening reserves and end-of-day charge target more protection.
